effects: Pulls exactly `assets` USDC from the signer into the vault via transferFrom, spending the signer's USDC allowance to the vault.
Mints previewDeposit(assets) vault shares to `onBehalf`; the share count depends on the current share price and has no minimum.
The deposited USDC is then allocated by the vault to its liquidity adapter (no further effect on the signer).
formats.shown: Deposit X USDC for <onBehalf>, with a constant 'Share ticker: gtusdcf' field and the share recipient.

findings.title: deposit: hard-coded 'Share ticker' gtusdcf does not match the vault share symbol gtUSDChy.
findings.evidence: descriptor metadata.constants.vaultTicker = "gtusdcf", shown as field 'Share ticker' (raw). Case 0 mined: shares minted to signer are asset 0x9a1d…6f3e symbol "gtUSDChy"; "gtusdcf" is the symbol of 0xc582…754e, the separate vault the liquidity adapter supplies to (minted to 0x8084… in the same tx). VaultV2.setSymbol lets the owner change the symbol.
findings.fix: Drop the constant ticker, or show the share token via a tokenPath of @.to; if kept, set it to the vault's actual symbol.

findings.title: deposit: number of shares received is not shown; it comes from the share price.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets);` no minShares parameter. Case 0: signer received 2 gtUSDChy, not shown.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor; the share count is not in the calldata.

cases.notes: 2 USDC out shown exactly. Shares in to signer: recipient shown, amount absent, ticker shown as gtusdcf while the share token is gtUSDChy.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns previewWithdraw(assets) vault shares (rounded up) from `onBehalf`; no maximum on the share count.
If the caller is not `onBehalf`, spends the caller's share allowance from `onBehalf` by that share count.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly X USDC to <receiver>, with the share owner shown.

findings.title: withdraw: shares burned from the owner are not shown; the count comes from the share price.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(...)` → `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. Case 2: 14759.41 gtUSDChy burned from the signer, not on screen.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor; no maxShares parameter exists.

cases.notes: 15000 USDC in to signer shown exactly. Shares out: reader knew a position shrinks but not the 14759.41 share amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: If the caller is not `onBehalf`, spends the caller's share allowance from `onBehalf` by `shares`.
Sends previewRedeem(shares) USDC (rounded down) to `receiver`; no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem X shares to <receiver>, with the share owner; the asset received is never named.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never says USDC is received; the reader had to guess it.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem fields: shares, receiver, onBehalf only; no underlying field (mint has `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker`). VaultV2.exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets)`. Case 3: signer received 15259.398680 USDC; reader: 'likely USDC, not stated on screen'.
findings.fix: Add a field 'Receive asset' with value $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker, and say 'Redeem {shares} for USDC to {receiver}'.

findings.title: redeem: USDC amount received comes from the share price and has no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);` no minAssets parameter.

cases.notes: 15087.36 shares out shown. USDC in: neither asset nor amount on screen; reader guessed USDC with no amount.

effects: Pulls previewMint(shares) USDC (rounded up) from the signer via transferFrom; no maximum.
formats.shown: Mint X shares for <onBehalf>, with 'Deposit asset: USDC' but no USDC amount.

findings.title: mint: intent 'Mint' and the sentence never say USDC leaves the signer.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint intent "Mint", interpolatedIntent "Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}". VaultV2.enter: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)`. Case 1: 1 unit of USDC left the signer.
findings.fix: Intent 'Deposit USDC for shares'; interpolatedIntent 'Pay USDC to mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}'.

findings.title: mint: USDC amount paid comes from the share price and has no maximum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.mint: `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares);` no maxAssets parameter. Case 1: 0.000001 USDC out, not shown.

cases.notes: USDC out: asset named in a field, amount absent. Shares went to 0x…dEaD (not the signer), shown correctly.
